code_summary: Pengiriman SMS batch ada di NotificationSmsEmailJob, tetapi untuk reminder ENA/RD*/DN*; tidak ada SMS berisi detail court summons.
note: Story: kirim SMS reminder berisi detail court summons ke defendant individu unik. Status kosong, demo_remark 'Check with Rafif if function is ready. I recall seeing a court SMS on test phone' (klaim, bukan bukti). Dicoba sinonim: state court, adjudicat, court mention, mention_date, hearing, court_case, courtreminder; di semua enam repo. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo; kode hanya memakai DataHive (NotificationSmsEmailHelper). Infrastruktur SMS batch ada, tetapi dipakai untuk reminder ENA/RD*/DN*, bukan summons court. Mekanisme eNotification yang ada (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java) memilih notice stage ENA/RD1/RD2/RR3/DN1/DN2/DR3 dengan parameter ENOTEDAYS per stage (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1108-1114), bukan notice court berdasarkan court mention date; ia dimatikan di prod (cron.notification.enabled=false, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); nilai server asli cannot verify from repo. Nilai notification.sms.enabled default true (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:53), sms.enable=false di application-prod.properties:87 (apakah property itu menggating jalur ini cannot verify from repo).
recommendation: Evidence 33%. Jangan klaim fitur State Courts/court reminder; yang ada hanya mekanisme eNotification umum.
